blocking_findings.summary: Hard-floor destructive asks can be auto-approved from remembered memory (apps/core/src/runtime/permission-decision-coordinator.ts:301): When a destructive rail ASK sets `hardFloor: true`, `exactAllowCanOverride` still enters this block.

[P1] Do not seal a stage when its required test never ran (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1596): When no JUnit testcase matches the required test id, this branch records a note and continues, allowing `stage done` to succeed.

[P1] Remove the retained single-file stage compatibility path (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:169): The new per-task stage-record implementation still reads and merges the replaced `stages.json` layout, and task worktrees intentionally preserve that old file until a story-side split.

ASKFLOOR-1-T5a-AC1: CENTRAL COPY. NEW `channels/permission-card-affordances.ts` exports `buildPermissionCardAffordances(input) → PermissionCardAffordances` and the label/line formatters; eligible single-ask cards render, in order, **Allow** (remembered, default) / the one alternative (ruling 5) / **Just this once** / **No**; pre-tap block: "Allow will remember: <scope noun>" (writes: "writing to <path> — any future content, no more asking for this file"), then the alternative's line (ruling 5 templates) when present, ending with "No will remember: this exact action."; post-tap: "Remembered: <scope>. Change it any time with /permissions." (writes: "Remembered: writes to <path> (any content). …"; No: "I'll keep saying no to this exact action. Change it with /permissions."; Just this once: today's receipt). Destructive: normal three buttons, no alternative, pre-tap "Allow will remember: this exact command only — nothing broader. No will remember: this exact command." Protected: reason line "<path> is protected, so I always ask.", buttons **Allow once** / **No** (remembered) only. Scope nouns: "this exact action" / "this kind of action, anywhere" / "only in <folder>"; trust-growth label per the owner ruling (human label → card's tool name → no button). No rails-bump line. `permission-interaction.ts` ≤ 700. Unit tests: every shape, order, every literal line, family > trust > folder precedence, destructive/protected exclusions, the missing-label fallback chain.

ASKFLOOR-1-T5a-AC2: PERSISTED RENDER MODEL + OFFERED-SET CHECK. `cardAffordances` is derived host-side on both prompt paths (ruling 1) from the T3c context + `canonicalRoot` (ruling 3) + the rail-version-filtered trust-growth count (ruling 4), set on the request (`types.ts` line-neutral), snapshotted by the envelope/binding, carried by the IPC payload updater and inline creation, replayed by recovery, and reset to the scalar batch shape inside the Postgres bind transaction (ruling 2). At settlement (claim, recovery, and Telegram's live claim) a remember code not in `offered` becomes its scalar base before application and learning; the tapped code reaches the receipt formatter (ruling 5). Tests: `ipc-interaction-handler.test.ts` — model persisted on the IPC path, forged unoffered code → scalar base + nothing learned; inline suite — model at creation; `pending-interaction-permission-recovery-orchestrator.test.ts` — recovery replays the model, applies the check, and an offered code yields its remembered receipt while an unoffered one yields the once-only receipt; `worker-coordination.postgres.integration.test.ts` — batch bind resets the model atomically; `pending-interaction-durability.test.ts` — envelope round-trip.

ASKFLOOR-1-T5a-AC8: S4 + GATES + DECISION. `askfloor-tap-budget.test.ts` adds S4 (`rm -rf build` asks once; Allow remembers exact command + target; identical command → zero taps; `rm -rf dist` asks; No is remembered exactly). `docs/decisions/0154` carries the owner-confirmed amendment (no rails-bump re-ask line; old-version rows inert and simply not listed by `/permissions`, per its line 18). Existing unit and Postgres suites pass; tsc and check:architecture green; ceilings: 700 default (permission-interaction 693, Discord interactions 699, Teams cards 688 today — extract), Slack `channel-interactions.ts` ≤ 712, Telegram `callback-handlers.ts` ≤ 900; no wrapper, shim, alias, dead branch or compatibility naming.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Write receipts can promise broader memory than is persisted (apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:46): The write-specific copy is selected solely from tool identity and the presence of a path, without checking `rememberContext.candidates.exact.pathOnly`.

Keep all permission-card copy in the required formatter module (apps/core/src/application/permissions/permission-card-affordances.ts:47): The application-layer builder constructs scope sentences, alternative labels, and pre/post-tap literals here, while `channels/permission-card-affordances.ts` separately owns button labels.

[P2] Keep out-of-scope writes as a stage-closing failure (factory/scripts/forge_cli/stages.py:1268): `_measure` now returns declared-scope violations as metadata instead of refusing the close, so a reviewed stage can be marked done while containing product changes outside its task's write scope.

[P2] Determine review-fix dependents from the DAG, not list position (factory/scripts/forge_cli/tasks.py:414): The new execution model explicitly makes dependencies, rather than decomposition order, authoritative, but `--review-fix` still treats every later active or done stage as having built on the reopened task.
